target_region: synthetic urban structures / building-like rectangular regions

dataset.name: Procedurally generated synthetic urban satellite-style tiles
dataset.redistribution: safe synthetic samples generated by this repository
dataset.image_format: in-memory float32 RGB arrays; public demo samples exported as PNG
dataset.mask_format: binary single-channel masks; public demo samples exported as PNG

input.normalization: convert to float32 and divide 8-bit pixels by 255

model.inference_loading: compile=False, so training-only custom metrics are not required

limitations: The training data are synthetic and visually simple.
A threshold baseline is marginally better than the U-Net on the generated test set.
Near-perfect scores do not demonstrate generalization to real satellite imagery.
Clouds, shadows, seasonal variation, different sensors, and different spatial resolutions are not represented.
responsible_use: Educational and portfolio demonstration only. Do not use predicted masks as the sole basis for emergency response, environmental enforcement, land ownership, military, legal, financial, agricultural, infrastructure, or public-policy decisions.
